info.about_md:
The [SpaceX REST API](https://github.com/r-spacex/SpaceX-API) is an open-source, community-maintained catalogue of SpaceX launches, vehicles, infrastructure, crew, and Starlink satellites. It is run by volunteer contributors at the [r-spacex](https://github.com/r-spacex) GitHub organisation and is independent of SpaceX itself. This SDK targets the `v5` base URL at `https://api.spacexdata.com/v5`.

What you can pull from the API:

- Past, upcoming, and "latest"/"next" launches with mission details and payloads.
- Rockets, cores, and capsules — including reuse history and current status.
- Launchpads and landing pads, with locations and status.
- Crew members, payloads, the Tesla Roadster trajectory, ships, and Starlink satellite TLE data.

The API is read-only and CORS-enabled, so it can be called directly from browser apps. No API key or authentication is required for the public endpoints. Published rate-limit numbers are not documented in the public docs; treat the service as best-effort and cache responses where possible.

entity_desc.capsule: Dragon capsule serial numbers with reuse counts, status, and mission history — `/capsules`.
entity_desc.core: First-stage booster cores, including reuse, landing attempts, and current status — `/cores`.
entity_desc.crew: Astronauts and crew members who have flown on SpaceX missions, with agency and status — `/crew`.
entity_desc.landpad: Landing pads and droneships used for booster recovery, with location and status — `/landpads`.
entity_desc.launch: Launch missions (past, upcoming, latest, next) with payloads, cores, links, and outcomes — `/launches`.
entity_desc.launchpad: Launch facilities such as LC-39A or SLC-40, with location, status, and associated rockets — `/launchpads`.
entity_desc.payload: Payloads carried on launches, including mass, orbit, customers, and manufacturer — `/payloads`.
entity_desc.roadster: Telemetry for the Tesla Roadster launched on Falcon Heavy's demo flight — `/roadster`.
entity_desc.rocket: Rocket families (Falcon 1, Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, Starship) with specs and success rates — `/rockets`.
entity_desc.ship: Recovery and support ships in the SpaceX fleet, with roles, ports, and status — `/ships`.
entity_desc.starlink: Individual Starlink satellites with TLE orbital elements and launch references — `/starlink`.
